scope: 3 neutral Luna/high controls, fresh context each, same full blinded manuscripts and180–300word review budget; independent rescoring of3 prior public-work prediction tests in fresh audit contexts; no new manuscripts or publication.

controls.limitation: Descriptive comparison; one neutral draw does not estimate sampling variance or causally identify persona effects.

public_prediction_audit.selection: All3 current profile-building checks with saved predictions before reading, selected before audit outputs.
public_prediction_audit.input: Exact prior predictions and heldout-at-construction public text only; withhold original self-grades and post-test profiles.
public_prediction_audit.purpose: Independent grading of original checks, not a fresh heldout prediction or validation of all23 people.

preserve: No original review or profile is overwritten. Archive input evidence before dispatch, outputs before synthesis.
comparability: Neutral controls reuse same rubric and short prose budget. Different contexts remain correlated base-model samples; no real-human fidelity or significance claim.
